_about: Set 3 of 4 (4 Nov 2026): offer-led heroes in the grammar of the Palmonas '9KT Pendant Free' card (an on-model beauty crop, the whole lockup at the bottom on a dark garment: wordmark, an upright serif offer, a sans qualifier, an outlined chip). Naira's own version: a blush backdrop the colour of the Naira gift box over a black silk camisole, so the top is light and the lower third dark, ivory type. Each card carries one true reason to buy now (the multi-buy, a price, free insured shipping, the gift box, cash on delivery), each checked against the storefront code and Shopify on 4 Nov. One piece per frame at its measured size.

common.scene: Behind her, a smooth seamless studio backdrop in a soft warm blush rose, matte, the colour of a pale pink gift box, filling the upper part of the frame. She wears a simple black silk camisole with thin straps, so the lowest third of the frame is the deep, plain black of the silk with nothing in it. Vertical 9:16 frame, the subject in the middle.
common.light: Light: one large soft warm key light from high on the left that wraps the skin in a gentle gradient, plus one small hard specular kicker from the right that puts crisp white points of light on the metal and natural fire in the stones. The sparkle is only tiny natural specular points: no star-shaped glints, no starburst, no lens flare. Rich tonal contrast; the jewellery is the brightest and sharpest thing in the frame. Shot on a 100mm macro portrait lens at f/4, the piece needle-sharp and the skin falling softly out of focus away from it. Warm, quiet, expensive, a luxury jewellery house campaign.
common.neg: No text, no letters, no logo, no watermark. No other jewellery anywhere on her except the one piece. No eyes in frame. Never enlarge the piece; it must look small and true to life on her body. No plastic skin, no CGI look, no blur on the piece.

ads.shot: A luxury jewellery campaign photograph: a tight beauty crop of an Indian woman from her lips down to her chest, one hand raised to her face with the fingertips resting lightly along her jaw, so the wrist and the bracelet sit high, beside her neck at the middle of the frame, the bracelet turned towards the camera; her other arm relaxed at her side.
ads.lock: She wears the bracelet from reference 1 on that wrist, reproduced exactly: identical 18k gold tone, identical single row of clear crystal rectangular baguette cut cubic zirconia set crosswise side by side, each stone held at its corners by fine gold claws, identical box clasp. Do not redesign, restyle, resize or add anything to the piece; the stones stay small crosswise baguettes in one single fine row, never round stones, never a double row, never a wide cuff.
ads.scale: CRITICAL SCALE: the line of stones is only 6mm wide, about the width of a pencil and narrower than her little finger, sitting snugly around a slim wrist; each baguette is about the size of a grain of rice. A soft contact shadow where the bracelet rests on her skin.
ads.skin: Her skin is a warm medium brown, glowing and real, with fine pores and a soft natural sheen; minimal makeup; short almond nails in a sheer nude polish.
ads.scene: Behind her, a smooth seamless studio backdrop in a soft warm blush rose, matte, the colour of a pale pink gift box. She wears a simple black silk camisole with thin straps, so the lowest 40% of the frame is the deep, plain black of the silk with nothing bright in it. Vertical 9:16 frame, the subject in the middle.
ads.redo_b: first try: the bracelet sat at 62-72% of the frame height, inside the type zone

ads.shot: A luxury jewellery campaign photograph: a tight beauty crop of an Indian woman's ear, jaw and neck in three-quarter profile, her dark hair swept into a sleek low bun, the corner of her lips at the edge of the frame, her bare shoulder and a thin black silk camisole strap below; one huggie on the visible earlobe.
ads.lock: She wears one huggie from reference 1 on the visible earlobe, reproduced exactly: identical 18k gold tone, identical wide flat band about 6mm deep with a soft brushed satin finish, identical rounded huggie shape about 14mm by 9.8mm, zero stones. Do not redesign, restyle, resize or add anything to the piece; the brushed satin finish must stay matte and light-scattering, never a mirror polish, and the band stays wide and flat, never a thin wire hoop.
ads.scale: CRITICAL SCALE: the huggie is small, about 14mm tall, about the size of her fingernail, hugging the earlobe tightly, its lowest point only a few millimetres below the bottom of the lobe; the whole huggie is shorter than the earlobe is tall and less than a quarter of the height of the ear. A soft contact shadow where it touches the skin.
ads.skin: Her skin is a light warm wheatish tone, glowing and real, with fine pores and fine baby hairs at the hairline; minimal makeup.
ads.scene: Behind her, a smooth seamless studio backdrop in a soft warm blush rose, matte, the colour of a pale pink gift box. The lowest third of the frame is her shoulder and the black silk camisole falling into deep, plain shadow with nothing in it. Vertical 9:16 frame, the subject in the middle.

ads.shot: A luxury jewellery campaign photograph: a tight beauty crop of an Indian woman from her chin down to her chest, one hand resting flat and relaxed on her collarbone, the fingers together, the ring on her index finger turned towards the camera.
ads.lock: She wears the ring from reference 1 on her index finger, reproduced exactly: identical 18k gold tone open band about 1.5mm thick, identical two stones side by side on top: one opaque oval natural tiger eye, banded brown and gold with a soft moving sheen, about 11.8mm, and beside it one faceted pale champagne crystal, each held in its own irregular gold bezel. Do not redesign, restyle, resize or add anything to the piece; the two stones stay two separate stones of different kinds, the tiger eye opaque and banded, the crystal clear and faceted, never two matching stones and never one merged stone.
ads.scale: CRITICAL SCALE: the tiger eye is about 11.8mm, about the width of her fingernail; the whole ring head is only a little wider than her finger, never a large cocktail dome. A soft contact shadow where the band meets the skin.
ads.skin: Her skin is a deep, rich brown, glowing and real, with fine pores and natural knuckle creases; minimal makeup; short almond nails in a sheer nude polish.

ads.shot: A luxury jewellery campaign photograph: a tight beauty crop of an Indian woman's ear, jaw and neck in profile, her fingertips lightly touching the hoop at her earlobe, her dark hair tucked behind the ear and pinned up, a thin black silk camisole strap at her shoulder; one hoop on the visible earlobe.
ads.lock: She wears one hoop from reference 1 on the visible earlobe, reproduced exactly: identical 18k gold tone small hoop about 23mm tall and 20.5mm wide, identical lower curve crowded with short faceted gold beads, slightly jumbled, identical single round white shell pearl of about 10mm held inside the hoop, identical hinged lever back. Do not redesign, restyle, resize or add anything to the piece; the beaded lower curve stays faceted and textured, never a smooth tube, and the single pearl stays inside the hoop.
ads.scale: CRITICAL SCALE: the hoop is 23mm tall, about the length of the top joint of her thumb, hanging from the lobe with its lowest point well above the line of the jaw; the pearl is 10mm, about the size of a chickpea, smaller than her fingertip. A soft contact shadow on the neck.
ads.skin: Her skin is a medium wheatish olive, glowing and real, with fine pores; minimal makeup; short almond nails in a sheer nude polish.
ads.scene: Behind her, a smooth seamless studio backdrop in a soft warm blush rose, matte, the colour of a pale pink gift box. The lowest third of the frame is her shoulder and the black silk camisole falling into deep, plain shadow with nothing in it. Vertical 9:16 frame, the subject in the middle.

ads.lock: She wears one hoop from reference 1 on the visible earlobe, reproduced exactly: identical bright silver tone rhodium metal, identical chunky hoop about 22mm across, set all the way round the front with square emerald cut green cubic zirconia alternating with pairs of clear baguettes, each in bright claws, identical post back. Do not redesign, restyle, resize or add anything to the piece; the metal stays cool bright silver tone, never gold, and the stones keep alternating, one green square then two clear baguettes, all the way round.

ads.skin: Her skin is a dusky deep brown, glowing and real, with fine pores and a soft natural sheen; minimal makeup.

ads.edit_c: frame a edited three times: 0.74 of the ear's height at first, 0.61 and 0.54 after two passes; a third pass did not shrink it. Pass d is used: 0.54 of the ear, the same as the live listing's own 'worn, shown at true size' photo (0.52), still about 1.3x by the ear rule
